_help: One entry per ballroom door. The key ("1"-"4") is what each door's QR code carries. name: shown on the printed QR sign. x, y: where the You Are Here pin goes on the floor map, on its 360-wide by 198-tall grid ((0,0) is top-left). label: where the pin's label goes, "above", "below", "left", or "right" (use left/right for doors on the side walls). Doors 2-4 are PLACEHOLDER positions until the real door locations are known.
